runeImages: Preserved embedded rune artwork from the supplied HTML.
importerAttribution: Tiered unique import, and the sets / sacred-unique parsing in lib/docs-catalog.mjs, adapted from azadix/medianxl-db (MIT). See THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt.
gemImages: Gem artwork from docs.median-xl.com/images/runes, embedded in socketable-images.json.
liveCatalog: Sacred uniques, sets, socketables and base items are refreshed at build time (prebuild) and fetched live at runtime from /api/catalog. The bundled snapshot date is in catalog-meta.json.
planner: Skills, trees, class stats, charms, relics and icons: azadix/medianxl-db (MIT), commit recorded in public/planner/data.json (dataset 2.14). Game rules: Median XL patch notes and docs (see src/planner/rules.js).

files: medianxl-YmludGJsdHh0.mpq (game tables: skills.bin, skills2.bin, skilldesc.bin, skillscode.bin, skilldesccode.bin, skillcalc.bin, string tables)
gameFiles.method: scripts/extract-game-data.mjs reads the installed game's MPQ archives (scripts/lib/mpq.mjs) and compiled D2 1.13c tables; output with file hashes in data/game/2.14.4/skills.json. Merged into the planner only when its major.minor matches the MedianDB dataset (scripts/lib/merge-game.mjs).
gameFiles.inGameObservations: data/game/2.14.4/fixtures.json (Way of the Spider tooltip screenshot, 2026-09-25)

mechanics.weaponPoison: Median XL forum poison mechanics guide (October 2021, before 2.0): weapon poison isn't raised by (poison) spell damage; item durations average. Treated as inferred for 2.14.
mechanics.patchNotes: Median XL changelog, patch 2.3 (Scorpion Blade scales with spell damage)

itemArt: Inventory art rendered from the installed Median XL 2.14.4 (uniqueitems/setitems/weapons/armor/misc.bin, DC6 graphics, pal.dat and item colour maps) by scripts/extract-item-art.mjs; manifest in data/game/2.14.4/item-art.json.
